purpose: Canonical hash-bound target-free C0/C1 admission assembly. Both-admitted rows have priority; C0-only rows then retain their stronger C0 coordinate; C1-only rows are permitted solely as subsequent capacity gap fill. This contract has no exchange-write authority until a current-vintage no-order parity release is sealed.

no_order_portfolio_adapter.invariant: The adapter sorts only by portfolio_order_priority_bps in this mode while retaining auction_priority_bps as raw selected BCF EV.

identity_and_causality.population: C0 and C1 must share exactly equal candidate_id, __decision_ts__, __symbol__, and side_name identities before any admission is formed.
identity_and_causality.missing_score_or_mapper: fail closed; no C0/C1 family fallback and no stale monthly C1 package

admission.portfolio_order_formula: auction_priority_bps + 20000 for both-admitted rows; +10000 for C0-only rows; +0 for C1-only rows. The offsets are auction ordering only, never expected EV.
admission.candidate_creation: prohibited; only candidates admitted by at least one independently target-free family are retained

telemetry.invariant: The tier order offsets are never used as raw expected gross, execution-adjusted EV, or realised-PnL calibration input.

required_before_exchange_activation: A current C0 and a current C1 mapper package, each fitted strictly from their declared prior-resolved windows.
A current append-only completed-15-minute C1 snapshot state.
An end-to-end no-order parity receipt from the current Router50 candidates through the tier selector, auction, execution preflight, and terminal telemetry fields.
A separate exchange-writing activation receipt binding the current artifacts and runtime hashes.
live_readiness.failure_mode: fail closed; this canonical inference successor does not authorize exchange access or order submission
